scope: Frozen StartLux/Qwen routing on fresh SQuAD articles; CLINC fitting data retained for exploration; CPU evidence demo

data.holdout_source: unused articles in pinned SQuAD2 train after excluding every article used by v1
data.sampling: fixed-seed hash order within gold class; question-weighted balanced target

policies.gain_target: P(Qwen correct given features) minus P(StartLux correct given features), both fitted from labels
policies.threshold: whole score-tie groups, largest validation deferral count not exceeding budget; runtime failures force deferral
policies.selection: highest validation cascade correct count; ties choose class_conditional
policies.original_gate: v1 refitted risk gate retained as secondary descriptive reference

evaluation.primary: fresh SQuAD paired accuracy difference of validation-selected v2 online policy minus validation-frozen confidence policy at target budget 10%
evaluation.actual_deferral: report holdout deferral rates; do not retune thresholds to force test quota
evaluation.secondary: descriptive direct baselines, rescue/harm, old gate and budget sensitivity; no unadjusted multiple significance claims
evaluation.power: no promised detectable effect; report interval width and source/cluster limitations
evaluation.holdout_access: evaluation requires valid policy freeze; idempotent verification allowed, policy changes after first evaluation rejected

openloop.policy_timing: fit and freeze before selected-cascade measurement; include policy CPU time
openloop.goodput: successful requests meeting arrival-to-completion SLO per offered-window second; all offered, rejected and failed counted
openloop.order: seeded randomized condition order within repeat; matched arrival schedule within rate/repeat
openloop.startup_warmup: record separately, exclude from steady-state offered window
openloop.drain: record all offered request outcomes after bounded submission, count late completion against SLO

optional.startlux9b: deferred until core results and resource feasibility are confirmed
